- Hell if I know. I'll check.
433:
- Excuse me, got a match?
- I don't smoke.
434:
- Well? - No, not him.
- A cop. - Definitely.
435:
We've checked the addresses
of Docent's accomplices.
No helmet.
436:
That leaves one possibility:
Prokhorov, the cloakroom attendant.
437:
But we couldn't check it.
Prokhorov never came to the meeting.
438:
He may have suspected something.
He quit his job and hasn't been home.
440:
Accept our deepest apologies
and sincere thanks. Take off the wig,
wash off the tattoos,
441:
go home and celebrate New Year.
Thank you very much.
- What about my men?
442:
We'll return your charges
to prison today.
443:
If you find the attendant,
might you need us again?
444:
I didn't want to tell you,
but Bely, the real Docent,
escaped today.
445:
Hard to believe, but true.
It's dangerous for you
to keep looking like him.
446:
Could they stay until tomorrow?
It is New Year, and in their own way,
they did try.
447:
We're out of town.
It's unlikely Docent will find us.
448:
All right, but don't leave the dacha.
Oh, we sent your letter
449:
to Sheremetyev's wife.
Here's her reply, addressed to him.
450:
- You'll have dinner with us
on New Year's Day? Promise?
- We promise!
451:
Shame. Such a nice woman,
but her father's a fence and a profiteer.
452:
What's all this shouting?
Who gave you permission to go out?
- Here he is... the bad person.
454:
The New Year is here. I hope
this year brings each of you a new life.
455:
Anything may happen, but remember:
wherever you are, wherever I am,
456:
I'll always remember you.
I'll make sure I find you.
457:
- And now... Just a moment.
- Where's he going?
458:
Who knows? You can't make sense
of him anymore.
459:
What's to make sense of?
He says he'll find us wherever we are
and slit our throats.
461:
They say he went like this
across Ryaboy's throat with a razor.
- He's gone feral, the jackal.
462:
Who's come to see you?
Father Frost, with presents for you!
463:
- Come here, Fedya.
- What did I do?
- Come on. Wear these in good health.
They're slippers.
464:
- What would I do with them?
I don't even have a home.
- You will. There's plenty ahead of you.
465:
- Meanwhile, you can wear them
in prison too. Here.
- You always have to jinx things.
466:
This is for you, Vasya.
And this is yours, Gavrila Petrovich.
- Thank you.
467:
- Pure wool.
- This one's yours too.
469: Sour stuff. It's no fun without vodka.
470:
- Must you drink yourself senseless?
- What else is there to do?
471:
We could just sit and talk
from the heart.
472:
I'm not a prosecutor.
I don't want a heart-to-heart with you.
- We could play a game.
473:
Listen to him! Think I'm a sucker?
You've got nine aces in your deck.
475:
Here's a good game: cities.
I say "Moscow."
476:
You take the last letter, W:
"Warsaw." Then you take W:
"Wellington." Understand?
477:
Now it's your turn, Fedya.
A city beginning with N.
478:
Vorkuta.
Why? I served time there.
479:
- All right. Yours must begin with A.
- Dzhambul.
- What has Dzhambul got to do with it?
480:
It's warm there. My home is there.
My mother is there.
481:
Let's play this instead.
I'll go out, you hide something,
and I'll find it.
482:
- You'd do better to find our helmet.
- Quiet.
483:
- We'll hide it, and he'll peek
through a hole?
- Then you go out and hide something.
484:
You watch to make sure I don't peek.
- Why me? It's always Fedya.
485:
- I'll rip your maw open, you little rat!
- Your maw, your maw...
486:
- Docent, were you ever little?
- I was.
487:
- Did you have a mother and father?
- Yes.
488:
Why are you so mean?
Why are you like a dog?
490:
- He came on his own.
- So you're here too.
491:
I was going to come to you,
but I could sense a trap.
492: Mityai, I need somewhere to hide.
494:
- Where are we going?
- Keep walking.
495:
- Sorry to trouble you for nothing,
Doctor.
- No trouble.
496:
Give him valerian drops and warm tea,
and let him sleep.
- Thank you.
497:
- Does it hurt, Garik?
- It hurts, Vasya. Read it.
499: "Dear Dad, we learned you're in prison,
500:
and we were very happy,
because we thought you'd died."
501:
Which bastard told the little one
his father's a jailbird?
502:
"Mom was happy too.
When your letter came,
she cried all day.
503:
She used to tell me
you were a test pilot."
505:
"But I'm glad you're alive,
because Mom says
507:
That's right! So weak-willed he nicked
our money and blamed the taxi driver.
508:
Get out! I'll knock your horns off,
you rotten radish!
510:
Aren't you ashamed?
You're forty years old.
Half your lives are behind you.
511:
What have you done?
What do you have now?
What lies ahead?
512:
Darkness, filth, nothing decent!
Come to your senses before it's too late.
That's my advice.
513:
Listen, Docent, we've got to leave.
The doctor's going to tell the police.
514:
- She won't. - Why not?
- I took my razor and cut her throat.
515:
She's down the well.
See for yourself.
516:
How long was my sentence?
One year.
518:
The kindergarten and the apartment?
Say ten!
520:
And for a lousy fourteen years,
I must put up with this snake?
521:
The one who put old woman in the well?
Do what you want. I'm going to the police.
523:
And you? Will you put up with him
until he kills you?
524:
Vasya, I told him earlier
I had a cold, and he...
525:
Enough about your cold.
Come here...
527:
- What are you doing?
- Cleaning the rug.
528:
Well, comrades, the comedy is over.
First, I'm taking this off.
530:
I'll serve my time, and that's it.
I'm going straight! I'll get a job.
531:
- Doing what?
- Watchman at my old collective farm.
- Why a watchman?
532:
I could shovel snow, lay bricks,
or be a translator. I know English.
533:
If only we'd brought helmet too!
Who is Docent? A crook.
534:
- Many crooks, but only one helmet.
- They'd reduce our sentences for it.
535:
Where did he put it?
I think we checked everywhere.
536:
Crook! I told you I had a cold.
All you said was, "Your maw, your maw!"
537:
- You made me dive in freezing water!
- When did he do that?
538:
When they caught us. Remember?
"I'm fishing, and you dive in."
539:
- Wait. What did he say about fishing?
- "I'm fishing through a hole in the ice.
540:
Squint, can you swim?"
- He hid the helmet in that hole!
541:
That's it! I remember, the bad man!
It's in the ice hole at Malakhovka!
542:
Why didn't you say so, you oaf?
Could've left a note before hanging yourself.
- Let's go.
543:
- What about him?
- Leave him for the police.
I'm not carrying that great lump. Come on!
545:
- There's nothing there.
- It's on the bottom. You have to dive.
546:
Why me? It's always Squint.
Vasya, tell him to go in himself.
547: I can't! It's cold. I'll get sick.
548:
- You were just trying to hang yourself,
and now you're afraid of a cold?
- Greetings, sports fans!
550:
- Where's the boat station?
- Over there.
551:
I'd kill you all,
but I haven't got time!
552:
Now there are two of them.
And another one back at the dacha.
554:
- One!
- Well done, Fyodor Petrovich!
Well done!
555:
- Two.
- The more we hand over, the better.
